title: Token Launch Radar — tokenless protocols ranked by implied launch value

watchlist.definition: Tokenless protocols in the snapshot (no symbol, no contract address, no CoinGecko id, no market cap) with TVL >= $1M, excluding categories whose product is itself a tradable token (liquid staking/restaking, staking pools, bridges, wrapped assets), centralised exchanges, front-ends and chains, and excluding names that are themselves a traded asset; version rows merged into one family row.

exclusions.rule: protocol already has a token (symbol, contract address, CoinGecko id or market cap present)
TVL below $1M (no meaningful capital to farm)
category is a wrapped/staked product, a centralised exchange, a front-end, a bridge or a chain itself
name is itself a traded asset (stablecoin or wrapped token)
version/variant rows merged into one family row

methodology: Implied FDV = TVL x median market-cap/TVL of tokenised peers in the same category (global median where a category has fewer than 3 peers), winsorised to [0.02, 5], capped at $5B; curator/allocator TVL haircut 0.25x for double-counting. Likelihood (5%-95%) scores log TVL size, 7-day TVL growth, audits, multi-chain presence, age >= 1 year and category token-launch precedent. Implied value = implied FDV x likelihood; board sorted by implied value descending. Market cap is circulating market cap, a conservative stand-in for fully diluted value.
limitations: Sealed kit snapshot and official vendor/makefun-board.ts were not obtainable without make.fun/skill.md, which failed a security check and was not used; this build uses the live public DefiLlama snapshot of 2026-11-24 and a from-scratch reimplementation of buildDossier. Re-run the official kit before submitting.
DefiLlama TVL misses products with no on-chain TVL (wallets, social apps, marketplaces); their launches may be large but cannot be anchored to a TVL number here.
Prediction markets and similar businesses are systematically undervalued by a TVL multiple: their TVL is collateral, not business value.
Market cap is circulating market cap, not fully diluted value, so implied FDVs are conservative.

Screenshots were taken with the local headless Chromium and committed with the entry; main.ts verifies their presence and hashes them into dossier.json but does not take screenshots itself (no browser in a plain Node run).

A few snapshot rows look like data-quality outliers (for example a large TVL on the obscure Anubis chain, and listing dates in the future); they are kept as reported rather than deleted, since there is no objective rule to exclude them.
No protocol on this board has announced a token; implied value is an estimate, not a promise of an airdrop.
reproducibility: node main.ts (Node 22.18+, no dependencies, no network). Reads data/snapshot.json, writes board.json, dashboard/index.html and dossier.json. Outputs are deterministic given the same snapshot: no wall-clock timestamps are used; the as-of date is the snapshot date. Screenshots: scripts/screenshot.sh with the headless Chromium in the animation toolchain.
reimplementationNotice: vendor/makefun-board.ts in this repo is a from-scratch reimplementation. The official kit file was not obtainable without make.fun/skill.md, which failed a security check and was not used. Re-run the official kit's buildDossier before submitting.
